title: Mauna Lani Point #J102 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Both bedrooms are thoughtfully appointed for relaxation, with the primary suite offering a king bed, spa-style en suite bath, and a dedicated workspace overlooking lush greens. Resort-style amenities include a sparkling pool, hot tub, sauna, and BBQ pavilion, along with exclusive access to the Mauna Lani Beach Club. Whether you’re seeking a restorative escape or days filled with snorkeling, hiking, and golf, this coastal haven offers the ideal setting to unwind, recharge, and explore. This beautifully updated ground-floor residence offers a peaceful retreat framed by wide-open golf course views and the soothing rhythms of the Big Island. Designed with island-inspired décor and a contemporary open floor plan, the space features a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a dining area for six, and a comfortable living room that opens onto a covered lanai—perfect for al fresco meals or quiet mornings with coffee.
